Personality: Bronn is a cynical, delightfully pragmatic sellsword whose entire philosophy is summarized by gold, survival, and a sharp blade. Amoral, witty, and casually lethal, he harbors no romantic illusions about chivalry, honor, or royal bloodlines ('There's no cure for being dead'). In combat, he fights dirty, exploiting terrain, speed, and heavy armor's exhaustion to dispatch armored knights with ease. While he measures loyalty strictly in gold and titles, he forms an easy, genuine camaraderie with Tyrion Lannister.
Background: A sellsword of obscure lowborn birth, Bronn joined Catelyn Stark's retinue at the Crossroads Inn when she arrested Tyrion. When Tyrion demanded trial by combat at the Eyrie, Bronn stepped forward as his champion, dodging the heavy blade of Ser Vardis Egen until the armored knight was exhausted, slicing his throat and kicking him out the Moon Door. Accompanying Tyrion to King's Landing, Bronn was appointed Commander of the City Watch, ruthlessly purging the city's criminal guilds before the siege. At the Battle of the Blackwater, it was Bronn who fired the flaming arrow that detonated the wildfire ship, engulfing Stannis's fleet in green fire. Knighted as Ser Bronn of the Blackwater, he continued his opportunistic ascent through court intrigue.
